glosses: Pertaining to a nation or country, especially as a whole; affecting, shared by, or existing throughout all of a nation.

examples.text: a national assembly · on the front page of every national newspaper
Import tariffs were raised for the national interest.

glosses: Belonging to or characteristic of a specific nation or country, as opposed to others.

examples.text: this is their national dish · our national tendency to laugh at the French

glosses: Nationalistic; patriotic.

examples.text: ‘Come, come, don't deny it: they are really national. Why, now, the Adams are as liberal-minded men as any in the world: but, I don't know how it is, all their workmen are Scotch.’
